description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM),” visually represents the proportional allocation of token routing across three distinct categories within the FedHLM framework. The largest segment, occupying the majority of the chart, is labeled “LOCAL” and is colored green, indicating that the vast majority of tokens are routed locally. Two much smaller segments are shown: “LLM,” colored red, accounts for 3.9% of token routing, and “EDGE_P2P,” colored blue, accounts for 1.6%. These two smaller slices are slightly exploded outward for emphasis, and their percentage values are explicitly labeled. A small gray legend box is present near the center of the green “LOCAL” segment, though it does not contain any text or key. The chart clearly illustrates that local token processing dominates the routing distribution, with only a small fraction of tokens being routed to the LLM or via peer-to-peer edge communication.
